thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm going to deprecate the old tracing hook snippet in the Console observability guide next Tue. PR is drafted but needs coordination.
liam: 👍 can you drop the PR link? need to update SDK snippets in the java/python examples too.
maya: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 — main change is replacing the v1 tracing hook sample with the `trace_context` wrapper and adding a migration note.
raj: Is the new snippet backwards compatible with our trace-to-dashboard fields? we had a shim in the runtime that kept field names the same.
sophia: The runtime shim preserves `x-trace-id` but the snippet changes how context is passed. We should add a short compatibility paragraph and an example mapping.
liam: I'll own the SDK snippet changes for python + node. planning to add both sync and async examples.
maya: Great — will you also update the dashboad examples that show cost/latency breakdown? they reference the old hook shape.
liam: Yep. Quick question: do we keep the old snippet in an appendix for 1 month or remove immediately?
raj: Ops prefers a brief deprecation window + a redirect from the old URL. That lets customers find the new example during rollout.
sophia: I can add a tiny migration guide: one-liner summary, before/after snippet, and a note about how KV-cache traces look after the change.
docsbot: PR #4123 opened by maya — reviewers requested: liam, sophia. CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck failed (1 broken link).
maya: The broken link is to an internal dashboard sample; fixing now.
liam: For the SDK snippets I'll add a test harness snippet so CI can run a minimal smoke test. samples/test_trace_hook_smoke.py
maya: Can we also schedule a quick staging preview? want to validate the rendering in Console and the embed width.
sophia: I can deploy the preview to staging later today. will post link here.
deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4123 — expires in 48h
raj: I checked the staging preview: mapping table looks good, but the cost breakdown chart still uses the old `latency_ms` label.
maya: thanks, raj — updating chart label in the PR.
liam: once I push SDK snippet commits, can someone approve? I want to merge before Friday to avoid the release freeze.
sophia: I'll review once deploy preview is updated.
docsbot: Linkcheck passed after update.
maya: final checklist: (1) SDK snippets updated (liam) (2) migration paragraph + mapping table (sophia) (3) chart label updated (maya) (4) staging preview validated (sophia/raj) (5) redirect + deprecation note configured (ops).
raj: Ops will add redirect and a 30-day deprecation banner after merge.
liam: pushed python/node snippets and smoke tests. PR now has new commits.
sophia: Reviewed and left a copy suggestion. small wording tweak, but not blocking.
maya: thanks — merging once CI green. I'll ping #announcements when it's live. :tada:
deploy-bot: PR #4123 merged by maya — staging -> prod deploy scheduled for 2024-11-02 03:00 UTC.
maya: Post-merge task: open a small follow-up to backfill the `trace-to-dashboard` tutorial with a migrated sample. i'll assign to sophia.
sophia: on it, will add a mini tutorial and a link from the main guide.
liam: sweet. thanks all for the quick turnaround.
maya: closing thread — feel free to re-open if something pops up.
